title: Unary Output in Polynomial Time
statement: For every pair of natural numbers $C$ and $e$, there are a finite Turing machine $M$ over the Boolean alphabet and a natural number $a$ such that, on every natural number $n$, $M$ computes the word consisting of $C(n+1)^e$ copies of true from an input of length $n$ within $a\bigl((n+1)^e+n+1\bigr)$ steps.
